CHENNAI EXPRESS FULL VIDEO SONGS
Presenting "One Two Three Four" full video from Shah Rukh Khan most anticipated movie of 2013 directed by much talented Rohit Shetty. The music of this movie is by Vishal Shekhar while lyrics are penned by Amitabh Bhattacharya.

Song: One Two Three Four
Singer: Vishal Dadlani, Hamsika Iyer
